 Paris Masters LIVE: Ruud underway vs Borges after Alcaraz ends Fritz's ATP Finals dream 
 Paris Masters LIVE: Ruud underway vs Borges after Alcaraz ends Fritz's ATP Finals dream
 Flashscore Ruud is in action vs Borges in a late-night clash Dubreuil Corinne/ ABACA / Abaca Press / Profimedia / Flashscore We have arrived at the quarter-final stage of the Paris Masters - a tournament blown wide open after a flurry of major upsets. Opportunities have arisen for surprise names, while Carlos Alcaraz remains the big favourite to win the title. Follow all the action with our Tennis Tracker!
 20:50 CET - Carlos Alcaraz has won an epic contest against Taylor Fritz to book his place in the semi-finals in Paris.
 After going a set and a break down, the world number three looked down and out, but Alcaraz dug deep to produce some of the best tennis of his 2026 season and turn the contest around, winning a three-set thriller 6-7, 7-5, 6-3 .
 And defeat means that Fritz has failed to qualify for the ATP Finals; instead, Alcaraz's fellow countryman Rafael Jodar has qualified for the first time.
 19:05 CET - Luca van Assche is a Masters 1000 semi-finalist for the very first time on home turf! The Frenchman is enjoying the best run of his career and has overcome qualifier Rinky Hijikata in an absolute slugfest,  6-4, 6-7(4), 7-5 , lasting two hours and 45 minutes.
 Van Assche is the youngest French player to reach the Paris semifinals since Richard Gasquet in 2007, and will now move to a career-high ranking of 34th in the world next Monday - at least! He faces the huge challenge of third seed Ben Shelton tomorrow.
 15:58 CET -  Ben Shelton has overcome fellow American Tommy Paul in a big serving contest, sealing his spot in the semi-finals of Paris with a 6-4, 4-6, 6-3 victory.
 The match whizzed by, with Shelton serving 19 aces and Paul seven on the fast indoor courts. However, Shelton prevailed in the big moments, as Paul played some really poor games at the end of the first set and the start of the third, which proved decisive.
 Shelton has actually done some of his other American friends a favour, though. With this result, Paul is now officially out of the race to the ATP Finals, and Frances Tiafoe has sealed his spot in Turin for the first time ever.
 Additionally, if  Taylor Fritz beats Carlos Alcaraz tonight, he will leapfrog Rafa Jodar into the final spot and qualify for the tournament. Fun!
 14:00 CET -  The first match will be getting underway in the coming minutes, as an all-American clash sees Ben Shelton and Tommy Paul lock horns.
 Follow the contest live with Flashscore! 
 Win probability Flashscore 12:00 CET -  Good afternoon and welcome to quarter-finals day at the Paris Masters!
 It is a big day for a few players as they look to secure qualification for the ATP Finals, including Tommy Paul , who is in action first against fellow American Ben Shelton at 14:00 CET .
 Paul must get to the final in Paris to have a chance of qualifying for Turin, but it won't be easy against the third seed.
 That is followed by two surprise packages, as Luca van Assche takes on Rinky Hijikata . Both players are appearing in their first Masters 1000 quarter-final, so there is a massive opportunity for the pair.
 The night session sees the match of the day, with favourite Carlos Alcaraz clashing with Taylor Fritz . Like Paul, Fritz is eyeing ATP Finals qualification, and needs to reach at least the semis to have a chance. He has been serving amazingly this week, but he won't have a tougher test than the Spaniard.
 Finally, Casper Ruud - who has looked fantastic on the indoor courts of Paris - meets Nuno Borges , who is another player in his first Masters quarter-final.
